validation_levels.V3: verified against reference implementation or published test cases

indicators.name: Monthly precipitation total
indicators.interpretation: Sum of valid daily (or provider monthly) precipitation

indicators.name: Monthly precipitation anomaly
indicators.interpretation: Departure from calendar-month baseline mean

indicators.name: Monthly precipitation anomaly
indicators.interpretation: Percent departure; null where climatological mean < 1 mm

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Index, 1-month
indicators.interpretation: Precipitation anomaly relative to baseline distribution
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not soil moisture, crop damage or water availability

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Index, 3-month
indicators.interpretation: Precipitation anomaly relative to baseline distribution
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not soil moisture, crop damage or water availability

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Index, 6-month
indicators.interpretation: Precipitation anomaly relative to baseline distribution
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not soil moisture, crop damage or water availability

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Index, 12-month
indicators.interpretation: Precipitation anomaly relative to baseline distribution
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not soil moisture, crop damage or water availability

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index, 3-month
indicators.interpretation: Climatic water balance (P - PET) anomaly; primary stream uses FAO-56 ET0
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not a z-score; PET stream must be stated

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index, 6-month
indicators.interpretation: Climatic water balance (P - PET) anomaly; primary stream uses FAO-56 ET0
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not a z-score; PET stream must be stated

indicators.name: Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index, 12-month
indicators.interpretation: Climatic water balance (P - PET) anomaly; primary stream uses FAO-56 ET0
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not a z-score; PET stream must be stated

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (standardised), 1-month
indicators.interpretation: Standardised ln of P/PET over k months

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (standardised), 3-month
indicators.interpretation: Standardised ln of P/PET over k months

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (standardised), 6-month
indicators.interpretation: Standardised ln of P/PET over k months

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (standardised), 12-month
indicators.interpretation: Standardised ln of P/PET over k months

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (normalised), 1-month
indicators.interpretation: alpha / mean(alpha) - 1

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (normalised), 3-month
indicators.interpretation: alpha / mean(alpha) - 1

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (normalised), 6-month
indicators.interpretation: alpha / mean(alpha) - 1

indicators.name: Reconnaissance Drought Index (normalised), 12-month
indicators.interpretation: alpha / mean(alpha) - 1

indicators.name: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration
indicators.interpretation: Grass-reference ET0 from meteorological inputs
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Not potential evaporation or actual ET
indicators.status: implemented (core only; ERA5-Land aggregation not built)

indicators.name: Drought event (onset, termination, duration, peak, severity)
indicators.interpretation: Run of index <= threshold (default -1.0); severity = sum(max(0, u - I))
indicators.must_not_be_interpreted_as: Frequency is not a return period

indicators.name: Water Requirement Satisfaction Index, season
indicators.interpretation: 100 * sum(ETa)/sum(ETc) from a daily bucket; rain-fed upper-bound stress
indicators.status: implemented (needs soil, cited crop parameters, daily forcing)

indicators.name: WRSI by growth stage
indicators.interpretation: As wrsi_season per stage

indicators.name: Days with Ks < 1
indicators.interpretation: Count of water-limited days in the season

indicators.name: Longest continuous water-limited spell
indicators.interpretation: Longest run of Ks < 1

indicators.name: Palmer Drought Severity Index
indicators.interpretation: Soil-moisture-based Palmer index (self-calibrating variant preferred)
indicators.status: blocked: soil AWC and validated implementation

indicators.name: Natural-vegetation NDVI anomaly
indicators.interpretation: Seasonal-baseline anomaly on natural vegetation only
indicators.status: blocked: MODIS, land cover, fire data
